stage: P3 controller PCB contact mapping and independent wiring reference comparison

user_report.source: User message in this project session
user_report.controller: Same physical controller as the working M5StickS3 reference project
user_report.numbering_scope: Connection numbers on the owned controller PCB, not the external 7-contact cable connector, UIAPduino GPIO labels, or IC package pin numbers

independent_sources.title: Bob Taylor: SNES Controller PCB Instructions
independent_sources.source_type: First-party assembly instructions for the author's controller PCB
independent_sources.finding: White +5V; yellow CLK; orange LAT; red DAT; brown GND. All five color/signal associations match the user report. The replacement five-contact connector ordering is not evidence for the numbering printed on the user's PCB.

independent_sources.title: Jim Christy: Super Nintendo Entertainment System: pinouts & protocol
independent_sources.source_type: Original hardware investigation; author reports measuring his SNES connectors
independent_sources.numbering_scope: External cable connector viewed into its contacts; explicitly author-assigned numbering, not an identified Nintendo numbering scheme
independent_sources.finding: Color/signal associations match. This document's external connector pin numbers differ from the reported controller PCB contacts.

assessment.color_signal_mapping: MATCH: all five associations in the checked independent references
assessment.pcb_vs_external_connector_numbers: Different scopes and numbering schemes; numeric differences alone do not establish an electrical wiring discrepancy
assessment.independent_confirmation_of_same_control: NOT ESTABLISHED: model/revision and PCB photographs are unavailable; retain 1..5 as a user report for this individual controller

publication.third_party_material: Source URLs and paraphrased factual mappings only; no copied images or source code
